When three friends sold their video games, Ryan, the first of the three friends, received $50 more than Jason from his sales. Jason received 30% more money than Zachary from selling his video games. If Zachary sold 40 games at $5 each, calculate the total amount of money the three friends received together from the sale of the video games.

First, calculate how much Zachary received from selling his video games:
\[ \text{Zachary's earnings} = 40 \text{ games} \times \$5/\text{game} = \$200 \]

Next, determine how much Jason received. Jason received 30% more than Zachary:
\[ \text{Jason's earnings} = \$200 + (0.30 \times \$200) = \$200 + \$60 = \$260 \]

Now, calculate how much Ryan received. Ryan received $50 more than Jason:
\[ \text{Ryan's earnings} = \$260 + \$50 = \$310 \]

Finally, sum the earnings of all three friends to find the total amount of money received:
\[ \text{Total earnings} = \$200 + \$260 + \$310 = \$770 \]

Thus, the total amount of money the three friends received together is:
\[ \text{Total earnings} = \$770 \]

FINAL: 770
